scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.rmSync(f, { force: true })); if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: node --no-warnings -e "const cp = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); cp.execSync('pnpm --filter @workspace/portfolio run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.cpSync('artifacts/portfolio/dist/public', 'public', { recursive: true });"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
